about.title: Association of Economists and Managers of Cameroon (AEGC)
about.creationDate: Established by prefectural decree of Mefou Afamba No. 00053/RDA/JOS/SAAJP dated March 3, 2025
about.presentationFirst: The Association of Economists and Managers of Cameroon (AEGC) is an independent academic and professional organization founded on September 8, 2021. Its mission is to structure and strengthen scientific research in economics, management and public policy in Cameroon, with a commitment to rigor, innovation and social impact.
about.presentationSecond: AEGC brings together academics, PhD students, executives, statisticians, planners and practitioners from a range of institutions, with the mission of connecting scientific research to the realities of national development.
activities: Promoting economic knowledge through research and scholarly publication
Organizing scientific conferences and inter-university seminars
Publishing peer-reviewed journals (AEGC Review of Economics and Policy, Revue Camerounaise de Gestion)
Research fellowships and certified training programs
Developing indicators for evaluating academic performance
Collecting and analyzing socioeconomic data through the Surveys and Statistics Unit
